tree.text: Invitation to Our School Library Opening Ceremony
tree.cn: 参加我校新图书馆启用仪式的邀请函

children.text: Salutation & Opening
children.cn: 称呼与开篇

children.text: Dear parents,
children.cn: 亲爱的家长们：
children.notes: 书信称呼，独立成行，后加逗号
children.statement: “Dear parents,” 是正式书信中常用的称呼语。
children.explanation: 在英文书信或邀请函中，Dear parents, 常用作面向全体家长的称呼。

children.text: I would like to invite you to the opening ceremony of our new library at No. 2 Middle School.
children.cn: 我想邀请您参加第二中学新图书馆的启用仪式。
children.notes: would like to do sth.: 想要做某事; opening ceremony: 开幕式/启用仪式; No. 2 Middle School: 第二中学
children.statement: “opening ceremony” 意为“开幕式”或“启用典礼”。
children.explanation: ceremony 意为“典礼，仪式”，opening ceremony 为固定短语。
children.keywords: invite, opening ceremony, new library, No. 2 Middle School

children.text: Event Details & Activities
children.cn: 活动安排与详情

children.text: The ceremony will start at 9:00 a.m. on 5 March.
children.cn: 典礼将于3月5日上午9点开始。
children.notes: start at: 在几点开始; on 5 March: 在3月5日（具体日期前用介词 on）
children.statement: 在具体某一天前，时间介词应使用 “on”。
children.explanation: 具体日期（如 5 March）前用介词 on，具体时刻前用 at。
children.keywords: ceremony, start at, 9:00 a.m., on 5 March

children.text: After the ceremony, you can take a tour of our beautiful school.
children.cn: 典礼结束后，您可以参观我们美丽的校园。
children.notes: take a tour of: 参观，游览; beautiful school: 美丽的学校
children.statement: “take a tour of” 与 “visit” 意思相近，表示参观游览。
children.explanation: take a tour of sth. 意为“游览/参观某地”。
children.keywords: after ceremony, take a tour, beautiful school

children.text: At noon, our dining hall will provide delicious lunch for all parents.
children.cn: 中午，我们的食堂将为所有家长提供美味的午餐。
children.notes: at noon: 在中午; dining hall: 食堂，餐厅; provide sth. for sb.: 为某人提供某物
children.statement: “provide sth. for sb.” 表示“为某人提供某物”。
children.explanation: provide 可以用于 provide sth. for sb. 或 provide sb. with sth.。
children.keywords: at noon, dining hall, provide lunch, for parents

children.text: We also hope each parent can bring a book to donate as a gift for the library.
children.cn: 我们也希望每位家长能带一本书捐赠给图书馆作为礼物。
children.notes: donate: 捐赠; as a gift: 作为礼物; each parent: 每位家长
children.explanation: donate sth. to sb./sth. 意为向某人或机构捐赠物品。
children.keywords: hope, each parent, bring a book, donate as a gift

children.text: Closing & Signature
children.cn: 结语与署名

children.text: Your presence will make this event truly meaningful.
children.cn: 您的到来将使这次活动真正富有意义。
children.notes: presence: 出席，到场（名词）; meaningful: 有意义的
children.explanation: presence 为 present 的名词形式，常用于正式邀请的致谢中。

children.text: We are looking forward to meeting you at the ceremony.
children.cn: 我们期待着在典礼上与您相见。
children.notes: look forward to doing sth.: 期待做某事（to 为介词）
children.statement: “look forward to” 中的 “to” 是介词，后面接动名词 “meeting”。
children.explanation: look forward to 后接动名词或名词，因此用 meeting。
children.keywords: looking forward to, meeting you, at the ceremony

children.text: Please reply in writing to this invitation by Friday, 2 March.
children.cn: 请于3月2日星期五前书面回复此邀请。
children.notes: reply in writing: 书面回复; by Friday: 在周五前
children.statement: “reply in writing” 意为“书面回复”。
children.explanation: in writing 表示“以书面形式”。
children.keywords: reply in writing, invitation, by Friday, 2 March

children.text: Zhang Wei, Headmaster
children.cn: 校长 张伟
children.explanation: headmaster 指男校长或中小学校长。

tree.text: Formal Invitation to the Opening Ceremony of Our New Library
tree.cn: 新图书馆启用仪式正式邀请函

children.text: Salutation & Opening
children.cn: 称呼与开篇

children.text: Dear parents,
children.cn: 亲爱的家长们：
children.notes: 书信称呼，独立成行，后加逗号
children.statement: “Dear parents,” 保持与基础范文一致的给定格式。
children.explanation: 题目给定句首称呼需原样保留。

children.text: I would like to invite you to the opening ceremony of our new library at No. 2 Middle School.
children.cn: 我想邀请您参加第二中学新图书馆的启用仪式。
children.notes: would like to invite: 诚挚邀请; opening ceremony: 启用仪式
children.statement: 开篇第一句为题目给定的开头句。
children.explanation: 按题目要求，给定句不计入字数，且两篇范文保持完全一致。
children.keywords: invite, opening ceremony, new library, No. 2 Middle School

children.text: Detailed Schedule & Library Donation
children.cn: 详细日程与图书捐赠

children.text: This grand ceremony is scheduled to take place at 9:00 a.m. on 5 March.
children.cn: 这一盛大典礼定于3月5日上午9点举行。
children.notes: be scheduled to: 定于……; take place: 举行; grand ceremony: 盛大典礼
children.statement: “take place” 通常指按计划发生或举行，不用于被动语态。
children.explanation: take place 是不及物短语，意为“举行，发生”，不能用被动语态。
children.keywords: grand ceremony, scheduled to, take place, 9:00 a.m., 5 March

children.text: Following the ceremony, you are warmly welcome to take a guided tour around our modern campus to experience our students' daily learning environment.
children.cn: 典礼结束后，热烈欢迎您在引导下参观我们现代化的校园，体验学生们的日常学习环境。
children.notes: following: 在……之后; guided tour: 有向导的参观; modern campus: 现代化校园; learning environment: 学习环境
children.statement: “Following” 在本句中作介词，相当于 “After”。
children.explanation: following 常用作介词，表示“在……之后”。
children.keywords: following ceremony, warmly welcome, guided tour, modern campus, learning environment

children.text: At midday, a delicious lunch will be served in the school dining hall so that we can have a pleasant chat.
children.cn: 中午，学校食堂将提供美味午餐，以便我们能愉快交流。
children.notes: at midday: 在正午; be served: 被提供/供应; so that: 以便，为了（引导目的状语从句）; pleasant chat: 愉快的交谈
children.statement: “so that” 引导的是目的状语从句。
children.explanation: so that 意为“以便，为了”，后接目的状语从句。
children.keywords: at midday, lunch served, dining hall, so that, pleasant chat

children.text: In addition, we would appreciate it if each family could donate a favourite book to enrich our new library collection.
children.cn: 此外，如果每个家庭能捐赠一本喜爱的书籍来丰富我们新图书馆的藏书，我们将不胜感激。
children.notes: in addition: 此外; appreciate it if: 如果……将不胜感激; enrich: 丰富; library collection: 图书馆藏书
children.statement: “would appreciate it if...” 是一种委婉客气的表达请求的句型。
children.explanation: I/We would appreciate it if... 意为“如果……我们将不胜感激”，it 为形式宾语。
children.keywords: in addition, appreciate it if, donate book, enrich library collection

children.text: Closing & Signature
children.cn: 结语与署名

children.text: We sincerely look forward to celebrating this memorable milestone together with all of you.
children.cn: 我们真诚地期待与大家一起庆祝这一难忘的里程碑。
children.notes: sincerely: 真诚地; look forward to doing sth.: 期待做某事; memorable milestone: 难忘的里程碑
children.statement: “milestone” 喻指历史或发展过程中的“里程碑，重大事件”。
children.explanation: milestone 原意为里程碑，常引申为人生或事业的重要转折点/里程碑事件。
children.keywords: sincerely look forward to, celebrating, memorable milestone

children.text: Please reply in writing to this invitation by Friday, 2 March.
children.cn: 请于3月2日星期五前书面回复此邀请。
children.notes: 题目给定的尾部结语，保持不变
children.statement: 此句为题目给定句，两篇范文保持完全一致且不计字数。
children.explanation: 给定结尾句严格保留原样。
children.keywords: reply in writing, invitation, by Friday, 2 March

children.text: Zhang Wei, Headmaster
children.cn: 校长 张伟
children.statement: 落款署名保持题目原样。
